record.question: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding a Government servant who is facing Departmental Proceedings?
options: shall not be allowed to appear in Departmental Examination.
shall be allowed to appear in Departmental Examination

shall be allowed to appear in Departmental Examination only if the Disciplinary authority, having regard to the circumstances of the case, is of the view that the imposition of the penalty of removal or dismissal from service would not be warranted in the case.
